claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded.

leg1_producer_baseline.detail: real cached OpenCaseLaw input builds a source-linked, duplicate-free, geometry-stable bundle for every frozen question

leg2_falsification_blanked_counter_evide.detail: counter_classifications_supported goes FALSE when counter_evidence stripped, proving contract live on real rows

leg3_falsification_broken_source_url.detail: source_urls_valid goes FALSE when canonical_url rep pointed off mcp.opencaselaw.ch, proving source validity live on real rows

counter_authority_yield.finding: COUNTER-AUTHORITY DISCOVERY IS EMPTY FOR 2/4 FROZEN QUESTIONS on the cached input. The counter channel returns rows, but the frozen marker_rule (norm_token AND limitation_token in title+regeste+snippet) selects none. This is a NEGATIVE RESULT, not claimed as a pass.
counter_authority_yield.not_claimed: this measures lexical marker yield under the frozen rule on cached rows; it is NOT a measurement of a learned or adjudicated counter classifier

recall_measured_not_thresholded.detail: recall figures reported with numerators and denominators but no thresholds introduced
